Exclusions. This section does not apply to 15 appropriations identified under subsection 2 that the 16 department of management, in consultation with the legislative 17 services agency, determines to be one-time appropriations. 18 For purposes of this subsection, “one-time appropriation” 19 may include but is not limited to an appropriation from the 20 rebuild Iowa infrastructure fund created in section 8.57 or the 21 technology reinvestment fund created in section 8.57C, or a 22 similar appropriation for an infrastructure project, technology 23 project, or temporary project or program for which a subsequent 24 fiscal year appropriation is not appropriate. 25 EXPLANATION 26 The inclusion of this explanation does not constitute agreement with 27 the explanation’s substance by the members of the general assembly. 28 This bill establishes continuing appropriations in fiscal 29 years for which the general assembly does not pass an annual 30 budget. The bill applies to fiscal years for which the general 31 assembly has not passed and presented to the governor, on or 32 before July 1 of the fiscal year, any bills appropriating 33 moneys for the fiscal year, with certain exclusions. The bill 34 ceases to apply for a fiscal year if, on or after July 1 of the 35 -3- LSB 6915XC (4) 91 ns/jh 3/ 5 S.F. _____ fiscal year, the general assembly passes and presents to the 1 governor one or more bills appropriating moneys for the fiscal 2 year. 3 For fiscal years to which the bill applies, the bill requires 4 the department of management (DOM), in consultation with the 5 legislative services agency (LSA), to identify the amounts of 6 all line item appropriations, standing limited appropriations, 7 and standing unlimited appropriations otherwise limited by law 8 for the immediately preceding fiscal year and the entities to 9 which those appropriations were made. The bill appropriates 10 those amounts to those entities for the fiscal year to which 11 the bill applies. 12 The bill supplants duplicative standing appropriations, 13 meaning the amounts for limited standing appropriations and 14 unlimited standing appropriations otherwise limited by law 15 identified for the immediately preceding fiscal year apply in 16 lieu of amounts estimated for the fiscal year to which the bill 17 applies. 18 The bill applies powers, duties, limitations, requirements, 19 allocations, nonreversions, and full-time equivalent position 20 authorizations associated with such appropriations from the 21 immediately preceding fiscal year for the fiscal year to which 22 the bill applies. 23 The bill excludes one-time appropriations from the 24 immediately preceding fiscal year, as determined by DOM in 25 consultation with LSA. One-time appropriations may include 26 but are not limited to appropriations for an infrastructure 27 project, technology project, or temporary project or program 28 for which a subsequent fiscal year appropriation is not 29 appropriate. 30 The bill does not reapply uncodified transfers from the 31 immediately preceding fiscal year. Codified transfers are not 32 affected by the bill and would operate in accordance with the 33 law during the fiscal year to which the bill applies. 34 The general assembly passed similar provisions in June 2020 35 -4- LSB 6915XC (4) 91 ns/jh 4/ 5 S.F. _____ applicable only to FY 2020-2021. 1 -5- LSB 6915XC (4) 91 ns/jh 5/ 5
